name: 48356 · Highland, MI
findings: ZIP 48356 (Highland) has 18 nonprofit organizations. 7 of them (39%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 7 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (100% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 48356 (Highland) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.
